name: Scintilla Commercial & Credit Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1990, Scintilla Commercial & Credit Ltd is in the business of Investment and Finance.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SCCL is registered as a non systematically
 important non-deposit taking Non-Banking 
Finance Company. It operates in the West
 Bengal and specialises in providing financial 
services. The company mainly does investments 
in various companies and provides loans.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.81 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 132 days to 58.9 days
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.15% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -0.37% over last 3 years.
